$schema: RyderTex export markets, real lat/long. Node pixel positions on the world map are computed from this data at runtime by js/map-render.js — never hand-place cx/cy again. projection.frame was measured on the original, uncropped 1577x800 render of assets/rydertex-assets/06-map/world-map-real.png (magick -fuzz 5% -trim), confirmed equirectangular by its ~2:1 content aspect ratio (1437x727) and the fact that Antarctica rendered as a full-width band — Mercator cannot render Antarctica at all. The PNG has since been cropped to 1577x660 (removing the near-empty Antarctica/southern-ocean band below ~65S) for display, but projection.frame.height stays 727 — that's the pixels-per-180-degrees scale constant, not the visible canvas height, and must not be rescaled to the crop or every latitude will shift.
